steps.label: Set NewtonsCradle preset (5 spheres, restitution 1.0/friction 0.0, one pulled back with initial velocity)
Precondition: spheres start at rest height y=0.5 (body 1, one of the 5)
Precondition: another sphere also at rest height (body 5, the pulled-back one)
Precondition: no contacts before the pulled-back sphere swings in (this dispatcher exposes no X getter, so the swing itself isn't directly observable -- only its consequence, contact events)
Pulled-back sphere swings in and strikes the row (spacing 1.02, gap 0.02, moving at 5 m/s -- closes within a few steps)
Let the momentum cascade finish propagating (~1s total)
Invariant: sphere stays at cradle height, not launched into the air or through the floor
Invariant: pulled-back sphere also stays at cradle height
